posts.text: Last week marked the end of my summer co-op with RBC Commercial Payments Technology, and looking back, I’m super grateful for how much I got to learn and take on with the support of my amazing team! I had a front-row seat to tech strategy in action, where I analyzed technology investments across multimillion-dollar portfolios and translated complex technical data into actionable insights for senior leaders. A big highlight was building MileCheck, an AI-enabled tool that automated a manual, error

This past weekend, I had the opportunity to participate in SheHacks+ 8 2024, Canada’s largest all-female and non-binary 36-hour hackathon hosted by the Women+ in Tech Society. From delving into new frameworks, coding through long nights, braving a snowstorm for midnight walks, to connecting with empowering and like-minded young women, every moment of this hackathon was truly unforgettable. Through perseverance, we were fortunate to have our app selected among the Top 5 overall projects! 🎉 Introd

I am thrilled to echo my teammate's gratitude to Big Blue Bubble for honoring our team at Hack Western 10. Winning Best Game Hack and securing a spot among the Top 5 Finalists is truly a fantastic start for our first hackathon! 🎉 A big thank you to everyone who contributed to this success. We look forward to next year!
